darwin.notes: macOS 1.2.4: improved M4A and library playback, short-clip export from long tracks, edit-limit guidance, smooth master volume control, compact controls and optional hints.

win32.notes: Windows 1.2.5: PITCH resets to +0.00 with a double-click anywhere on the control. Typed values accept only digits from 0 to 12 semitones.
